messages:
jules.reps: Heads-up: DeltaForge (analytics) is exploring swapping CompetitorX for Redwood. Their checklist: drop-in compatibility (minimal client changes), mapping CompetitorX size-bands to per-token billing, SCIM + BYOK, and detailed notes on response deltas that could break their ranking/score pipeline. Could presales/eng weigh in?
kai.se: I'll take point. They want a facade that preserves request/response shape (including webhook async callbacks). Any major caveats?
marina.eng: Main ones: tokenizer deltas that shift token counts (common, +/- 5-15 tokens), sampling default differences (temperature/top_p) that change outputs, and stop-sequence semantics. If they rely on exact stop truncation we should add an output-normalizer in the facade.
nora.solutions: Proposed POC: 1) gather 300 representative requests (NLU, summarize, extraction, webhooks), 2) run A/B vs CompetitorX and Redwood (standard + quantized), 3) measure major-regression rate, token distribution per band, and offset alignment failures for entity spans, 4) produce a finance-friendly billing estimator.
tony.security: Security needs: SCIM/SAML for provisioning, BYOK (AWS/GCP KMS) or HSM option for Private, audit log export to their SIEM, and SOC2 addendum + EU residency options. Please DM compliance contact + sample IP ranges.
oncall-bot: Deployment note: Hosted supports short-lived KV pinning via session headers for POC; Dedicated/Private support persistent KV cache pinning.
kai.se: Adapter mapping example (CompetitorX -> Redwood):
```
// CompetitorX sync
POST /api/v1/generate
{ "prompt": "Summarize...", "size":"M", "stop":"\\n\\n" }

// Redwood translation
POST /v1/completions
{ "model":"redwood-gen-a", "input":"Summarize...", "max_output_tokens":120, "stop_sequences":["\\n\\n"] }
```
Add normalizer to truncate exactly at their stop marker and preserve trailing newline expectations.
marina.eng: Engineering caveat: if their scoring uses character-offset spans, tokenization diffs will break offsets. We can implement an offset-mapping shim (char->token heuristics + fuzzy match) which catches most cases but not all. Add targeted edgecases: emoji, ligatures, and combined Unicode.
nora.solutions: For billing estimator: sample 500 responses per size-band from CompetitorX, compute avg tokens per band, then monthly_cost = avg_tokens * per_token_rate * monthly_volume. I'll put together a Colab and a one-pager for their finance team.
tony.security: For BYOK/HSM: Hosted can do customer-managed wrapping with contract; Dedicated/Private can integrate with customer KMS or HSM. I'll draft SA notes on key rotation, acceptable cipher suites, and required attestations.
kai.se: Acceptance criteria suggestion: (1) parity-suite (300 cases) <= 2.5% major regressions; (2) deterministic endpoints (where requested) match CompetitorX >=98% (modulo whitespace); (3) P95 latency under 700ms at their sample load (150 TPS); (4) billing projection within 12% after sampling; (5) security questionnaire completed and SOC2 addendum agreed.
jules.reps: Timeline: they asked for an internal demo in 9 business days. Can we meet that?
marina.eng: Plan: day 0-1 onboarding + security kickoff; day 2-4 build facade + smoke tests (preserve async contract); day 5-6 run parity & billing sampling; day 7 remediate (normalizer + offset shim); day 8 dry-run; day 9 demo.
nora.solutions: I'll prepare the parity harness and share a Colab link here when ready. Also will include a script to convert sample logs into monthly spend projections.
tony.security: I'll start the SA doc and request their compliance contact. Need IP allowlist and required attestations.
kai.se: I'll open the proxy repo and post initial smoke logs by EOD tomorrow. Expect an initial PR for the facade mapping.
jules.reps: Thanks team  keeping this thread as the canonical POC channel. :thumbsup:
